items.text:
I dock with a derelict. I cut open an inner airlock door.
Like something out of dead space, a man charges me through the wreckage of the door.
"I'MA MUGYA!" He screams so hard I can hear him through the vacuum of space.
I palm my smartgun loaded with gel rounds and proceed to shoot him in the balls.
"AIIIIIE!" He screams and proceeds to run away.
I spend 3 minutes chasing him through the derelict firing shots at him, the gel rounds seem completely ineffective at killing him through his space suit.
I fire off all 20 rounds of ammunition in my hand gun, the only ammunition I'm carrying on me.
Some where in the 17 or 18th shot his space suit finally breaks. He responds by rushing onto my ship to breath my atmo.
I chase him back onto my ship. I go past him to my locker while he gasps for breath. I open the locker.
"I surrender!" The man cries.
"Hi surrender. I'm reloaded." I shoot him.
10/10. Would run out of ammo again
items.text_zh:
我与一艘废弃飞船对接。我切开了一扇内部气闸门。
就像《死亡空间》里的场景，一个男人穿过门的残骸向我冲来。
“我是劫匪！”他尖叫得如此用力，我隔着太空真空都能听见。
我握紧装有凝胶弹的智能枪，接着射他的蛋蛋。
“啊啊啊啊！”他尖叫着跑开了。
我花了3分钟在废弃飞船里追他并朝他开枪，凝胶弹似乎完全无法穿透他的太空服杀死他。
我打光了手枪里全部20发子弹，那是我身上携带的唯一弹药。
大概在第17或第18发时，他的太空服终于破了。他的回应是冲进我的飞船呼吸我的大气。
我追着他回到我的船上。他喘着气时，我从他身边走过，来到我的储物柜前。我打开储物柜。
“我投降！”那男人喊道。
“嗨，投降。我重新装好弹了。”我开枪打了他。
10/10。还会再次打光弹药

observations.description: 凝胶弹对穿着宇航服的敌人完全无效
observations.evidence: the gel rounds seem completely ineffective at killing him through his space suit
observations.evidence_zh: 凝胶弹似乎完全无法穿透他的太空服杀死他
